headline: Google's AI reaches recursive self-improvement, raising clinical validation stakes
body: Sergey Brin announced that Google's AI models are achieving recursive self-improvement capabilities, marking a significant shift in AI system behavior. For healthcare AI, this development compounds existing validation challenges: self-improving models create moving targets for clinical evidence requirements, EHR integration testing, and regulatory approval pathways that assume static model behavior. Healthcare organizations and vendors must now evaluate whether current governance frameworks can govern systems that modify their own decision logic, particularly in high-stakes workflows like diagnostic support and treatment recommendations where clinical accountability remains non-negotiable.
